provenance.scope: AI public mock only; retrospective, nonblind; no human outcome
provenance.exposure: Coordinator compared the submitted public mock packet ID and hash with #155 mock admin record on 2026-11-26. The prior AI self-reported seeing admin materials; exact history of earlier key and assignment exposure is unknown. File hashes identify possible exposure, not proof of having read individual answers.
provenance.measurement: First compute five source-role visibility states on every page and alternative without response labels. Classify gray < 255 source support inside pinned ink boxes using union of half-open source pieces; separators excluded. none/some/all count zero/proper subset/all originally painted pixels; retain empty-original separately. All reference source and display files are opaque L; reject alpha/non-gray images explicitly. Pixel QA requires entire decoded display and separator equal. Geometry stages are alternatives, retrospective descriptive only.
provenance.packetImageEncoding: Embedded PNG byte SHA-256 is bound to pinned packet HTML and its canonical payload. Build PNG byte SHA-256 is bound to the manifest. The build PNG includes a pHYs chunk omitted from the embedded PNG. Dimensions and decoded opaque L pixels agree exactly.
